items.blurb: 5 charges, heavy, two-handed; concussive blast waves.

items.name: Sleep Cannon
items.blurb: 3 charges, heavy, two-handed, range 60/240; puts targets to sleep.

items.name: Burst Cannon
items.blurb: 3 charges, heavy, range 1,600 ft.; 4d10+10 elemental damage in a 20-ft. sphere (DC 16 Dex).

items.name: Polymorph Cannon
items.blurb: 3 charges, heavy, range 1,600 ft.; transforms what it hits.

items.name: Thunderclap Blaster
items.blurb: 3 charges, heavy, range 1,600 ft.; deafening thunder bursts.

items.name: Bionic Hand
items.blurb: +2 to Dexterity checks made with your hands (+4 with two).

items.name: Bionic Arm
items.blurb: +1 Athletics and one-handed melee damage; +2 with a pair (then covers two-handers too).

items.name: Bionic Eye
items.blurb: +2 sight-based Perception and +1 ranged attack rolls; a pair improves both.

items.name: Prehensile Tail
items.blurb: 5-ft.-reach tail that lifts, grapples, and makes unarmed strikes.

items.name: Bionic Legs
items.blurb: +10 ft. speed, triple jump distance, count one size larger for carrying.

items.name: Bionic Organs
items.blurb: +2 to Constitution checks and saving throws.

items.name: Bionic Wings
items.blurb: Fly 60 ft., up to 4 hours a day.

items.name: Bladed Hands
items.blurb: Hidden finger blades (1d4+Dex slashing), climb speed 10 ft.; includes bionic hand benefits.

items.name: Ensnaring Arm
items.blurb: Burst-open canister of restraining wires; grapples with advantage. Includes bionic arm benefits.

items.name: Blaster Arm
items.blurb: Concealed zap gun in the forearm (1d10 force); includes bionic arm benefits.

items.name: Eldritch Blast Eye
items.blurb: 1/day force blast: 3d8 and prone (DC 14 Dex); includes bionic eye benefits.

items.name: Vampiric Hand
items.blurb: Draining touch: 2d6 necrotic, heal half, 1 min/day. Banned in many places - black market.

items.name: Whip Tail
items.blurb: 15-ft. whip tail; bonus-action strike (1d6 piercing). Includes prehensile tail benefits.

items.name: Tremor Legs
items.blurb: Stomp shockwave: 2d6 in 10 ft. (DC 13 Dex), 1/short rest. Includes bionic legs benefits.

items.name: Assassin's Teapot
items.blurb: Tcho-Tcho teapot with a living dispenser inside; poisons one chosen cup on a hidden signal.

items.name: Formless Spawn Residue
items.blurb: Thrown flask of living acid: 6d10 acid, dissolves nearly anything, lingers where it lands.

items.name: Metamorphic Venom, Ignition
items.blurb: 3-stage serpentfolk weapon venom: poison, then fire, then flame-dousing.

items.name: Metamorphic Venom, Strike and Escape
items.blurb: 7-stage venom: blind, corrode, weaken, poison, smoke, and a healing salve.

items.name: Space Mead (brewed to order)
items.blurb: 10 days safe from the void of space, no need to eat, breathe, or drink. Order a year ahead.

items.name: Space Mead (preserved dose)
items.blurb: Sealed canister of space mead, ready when you are.

items.name: Wine of Pnoth (1 serving)
items.blurb: Gets you drunk permanently - the effects never wear off without magic.

items.name: Tcho-Tcho Oculus (fish eye)
items.blurb: Eat the pickled eye: advantage on sight Perception for 1 minute.

items.name: Tcho-Tcho Oculus (bird eye)
items.blurb: Sharp sight and initiative advantage for 10 minutes; passively pierces illusions.

items.name: Tcho-Tcho Oculus (human eye)
items.blurb: 8 hours of keen sight: advantage against sight-based illusions.

items.name: Abhoth Slime
items.blurb: Shatter the flask to spawn one of Abhoth's filth for 1 minute; barely controllable.

items.name: Atlach-Nacha Venom
items.blurb: Weapon venom milked from the spider-god: DC 17 Con or poisoned and paralyzed.

items.name: Pigments from Yuggoth
items.blurb: Paint that glows in darkness and can never be removed; covers a 5-ft. square.

items.name: Clithni
items.blurb: Emerald draught of longevity: subtract 1d10 years from your age.

items.name: Gorgondy
items.blurb: Evil liquor: DC 14 Cha save or slide toward evil; damns the already-wicked.

items.name: Milk of Shub-Niggurath
items.blurb: Cures poisons and ability damage, then +2 Str/Con... and a creeping monstrous mutation.

items.name: Selenine
items.blurb: Cures all disease and mutation; ends effects reducing max hp or ability scores.

items.name: Plutonian Drug
items.blurb: Vision of any point in past or future (as divination, unbound by time).

items.name: Sensory Machine (speech)
items.blurb: Mi-go device that speaks for whoever - or whatever - is plugged into it.

items.name: Sensory Machine (basic sense)
items.blurb: Grants one humanoid-quality sense via socket; sight version has darkvision 60 ft.

items.name: Sensory Machine (keen sense)
items.blurb: Superhuman sense: advantage on related Perception; sight version darkvision 120 ft.

items.name: Sensory Machine (extraordinary sense)
items.blurb: Echolocation, heat-sight, and stranger: tremorsense or blindsight 40 ft.

items.name: Sensory Machine (extradimensional sense)
items.blurb: Truesight 120 ft. and glimpses into the Mythos; human minds break processing it.

items.name: Brain Cylinder, Faulty
items.blurb: Extracts and briefly preserves a living brain; ask it 1d6 questions.

items.name: Brazen Head (uncommon)
items.blurb: Sentient brass bust that stores 1 spell level and casts on command; obsessed with Mythos lore.

items.name: Brazen Head (rare)
items.blurb: Stores 3 spell levels; senses 60 ft.; can serve as a familiar.

items.name: Brazen Head (very rare)
items.blurb: Stores 5 spell levels; senses 90 ft.

items.name: Brazen Head (legendary)
items.blurb: Stores 8 spell levels, truesight, and can burn stored spells to teleport.

items.name: Digestive Replacement
items.blurb: Mi-go organ graft: digest wood, seawater, toxins... but normal food may poison you.

items.name: Disk of the Hyades
items.blurb: Presented rune-disk holds undead at bay (DC 13 Wis).

items.name: Metamorphic Weapon
items.blurb: +1d6 poison on hit; disguises itself as a belt or trinket until triggered.

items.name: Seal of Hydra
items.blurb: Foils pickpockets and arcane-locks a container; alerts you to tampering at any distance.

items.name: Starstone of Mnar
items.blurb: +3 on Int/Wis/Cha saves against aberrations, oozes, and Mythos horrors.

items.name: Tiara of Mnar
items.blurb: Immune to exhaustion while worn - but it all comes due when removed.

items.name: Bokrug Egg
items.blurb: Clammy iron sphere; summons a ghost of Ib for 10 minutes, 1/day.

items.name: Chain of the Deep
items.blurb: You and nearby deep ones gain +1 to attacks and saves.

items.name: Flute of the Servitors
items.blurb: One alien note disrupts everyone's concentration for a minute - no save, including yours.

items.name: Leng Glass
items.blurb: Jagged glass that scries random distant places; controllable once a day, roughly.

items.name: Lightning Gun (yithian)
items.blurb: Great Race energy weapon: 20 charges, 150/600 ft., 1d10 lightning per charge spent.

items.name: Medallion of Y'ha-nthlei
items.blurb: Breathe and see clearly underwater; immune to depth, cold, and pressure.

items.name: Mist Projector
items.blurb: Mi-go freeze-ray: 30-ft. cone, 9d6 cold (DC 15 Con), ices the ground; 2 charges.

items.name: Idol of Cthulhu
items.blurb: 3 charges of dream sending of Cthulhu; the dreamer may commune with the sleeping god.

items.name: Ring of Eibon
items.blurb: Glimpses of the future: never surprised, advantage on initiative; 3 charges of battle foresight.

items.name: Aspect of the Snailephone
items.blurb: Imagine a Graham Bell telephone mixed with One-Piece-Snail-Phone. Installable only inside a Stable Bubble.

items.name: Portable Aspect of the Snailephone
items.blurb: A Graham Bell-style Cellular Snailephone.

items.name: Silver Key
items.blurb: Opens the way to the Dreamlands; 3 charges.

items.name: Sphere of Nath
items.blurb: Borrow the magical attributes of a distant location you know - be in two places at once.

items.name: Twsha (proto-shoggoth)
items.blurb: Blob of protoplasm that commands one specific proto-shoggoth. Almost never for sale.

items.name: Twsha (shoggoth)
items.blurb: Commands one specific shoggoth - while your concentration holds. Almost never for sale.

items.name: Lamp of Alhazred
items.blurb: Its light opens a two-way window to another time and place.

items.name: Panchromatic Armor
items.blurb: Serpentfolk plate that shifts color: +3 AC or immunity to a chosen damage type.

items.name: Ultra-Violet Resonator
items.blurb: Conjures 1d4 entities from the Mythos into view for a few rounds; 7 charges.

items.name: The Celaeno Fragments
items.blurb: Transcribed fragments of forbidden celestial lore.

items.name: The Eltdown Shards
items.blurb: Pre-human ceramic fragments describing the Great Race.

items.name: R'lyeh Text
items.blurb: Chronicle of sunken R'lyeh and the cult of Cthulhu.

items.name: The Zanthu Tablets
items.blurb: Engraved testament of a high priest of Ythogtha.

items.name: The Book of Dzyan
items.blurb: Theosophical secrets predating humanity.

items.name: The Book of Eibon
items.blurb: Hyperborean wizard's life, prophecies, and formulas (Elder Sign, byakhee rites).

items.name: Cryptical Books of Hsan (one book)
items.blurb: A single volume of the seven cryptical books.

items.name: The Pnakotic Manuscripts
items.blurb: The Great Race's own records, copied and recopied through eons.

items.name: Revelations of Gla'aki
items.blurb: Cult scriptures penned by the undead servants of Gla'aki.

items.name: Cryptical Books of Hsan (all seven)
items.blurb: The complete seven-volume set.

items.name: Cultes des Goules
items.blurb: The ghoul-cults of old, and what they feed on.

items.name: De Vermis Mysteriis
items.blurb: Mysteries of the Worm: necromancy and star-daemon lore.

items.name: Von Unaussprechlichen Kulten
items.blurb: Von Junzt's survey of nameless cults - he died horribly for it.

items.name: The King in Yellow
items.blurb: The play that must not be read past Act One.

items.name: The Necronomicon
items.blurb: Abdul Alhazred's masterwork; the deepest well of Mythos knowledge.

items.name: Focal Conversion
items.blurb: Etches any firearm into an arcane, holy, or druidic focus. While holding the gun, you cast through it.

items.name: Glyph Sights
items.blurb: +1 to spell attack rolls for spells cast through the gun.

items.name: Channel Barrel
items.blurb: Ranged-attack cantrips cast through the gun use the gun's range if that's better.

items.name: Witchfire Hammer
items.blurb: After you cast a leveled spell as your action: bonus action spark shot — ranged spell attack, gun range, 2d8 piercing or fire. Each use raises the gun's misfire by 1 until cleaned (1 min).

items.name: Aegis Stock
items.blurb: +1 AC while you wield the gun in both hands.

items.name: Warded Grip
items.blurb: 1/short rest, automatically succeed on one DC 10 concentration save while holding the gun.

items.name: Hexdrinker Suppressor
items.blurb: Casting through the gun is muffled: checks to notice you casting have disadvantage.

items.name: Spellstore Cylinder
items.blurb: Holds one 1st-level spell cast into it; anyone holding the gun can fire the stored spell as an action.

items.name: Pact Chamber
items.blurb: The gun is a pact weapon and focus. When a hostile creature you can see dies within gun range, your next spell attack through it before your next turn ends gains +1d4.

items.name: Sigil Cylinder: Guidance
items.blurb: 3 charges, regained at dawn: bonus action, spin the cylinder to gain guidance on yourself (concentration as normal).

items.name: Misfire Ward Charm
items.blurb: Hangs from any firearm: 1/day, negate one misfire.

items.name: Cartridge of Components
items.blurb: Bandolier-cylinder component pouch; satisfies material and somatic requirements even while your hands hold a gun or shield.

items.name: Dusk Rounds (6)
items.blurb: The fired round blooms 10-ft.-radius magical twilight (dim light) for 1 minute where it lands.

items.name: Glimmer Rounds (10)
items.blurb: On hit the target shimmers: the next attack roll against it before your next turn has advantage.

items.name: Thunderclap Rounds (5)
items.blurb: Impact cracks like thunder (heard 300 ft.); each creature within 5 ft. takes 1d6 thunder, DC 12 Con negates.

items.name: Gilded Finger-Irons
items.blurb: Six gilt fingertips — your finger guns are legit: bonus action ranged spell attack (Cha), 30/120 ft., 1d8+Cha force, magical. Hands stay free for an instrument; the set is a bard focus.

items.name: Vesper, the Gloaming Six
items.blurb: Revolver, holy symbol, and arcane focus in one. +1 spell save DC while held. 3 dusk shells/long rest: reaction when a creature within 30 ft. attacks — fire skyward, that attack has disadvantage.

items.name: Concealed Light Duty Armor
items.blurb: Light Duty Armor (AC 14 + Dex max 2, BR 3) tailored as fine clothes; spotting it as armor takes a DC 15 Investigation check.

items.name: Ironweave Bolas +1 (3)
items.blurb: Three Quality +1 Bolas (1d4 bludgeoning, monk weapon, thrown 50/100): escape DC 14, AC 12, 10 hp each.

items.name: Loyal Bola
items.blurb: On a miss this bola snaps back to your hand; on a hit it stays wrapped on the target (DC 12 escape).

items.name: Focus-Core Walking Cane
items.blurb: Walking cane (1d8, hidden blade, versatile) with a spellcasting focus set in the handle — arcane or holy, made to order.

items.name: Resonant Tocken
items.blurb: Mallet-struck tocken; bard focus. When you grant Bardic Inspiration to a creature within 30 ft., it also gains temp hp equal to your Cha modifier.

items.name: Vicar's Half-Mask
items.blurb: Porcelain half-mask holy symbol. 1/day cast disguise self; witnesses recall the masked face only hazily (disadvantage to identify you).

items.name: Coachman's Gloves
items.blurb: Drawing thrown weapons or ammunition is free, and you can draw two thrown weapons at once.

items.name: Bandolier of Ready Things
items.blurb: Six loops; stowing or retrieving any looped item (potions included) is a free interaction.

items.name: Hatpin of the Unfazed
items.blurb: Pin it to any hat: 1/day, reroll a failed Wisdom saving throw.

items.name: Assayer's Monocle
items.blurb: 3/day, after 1 minute's study: learn whether an object is magical and its school — no ritual, no components.

items.name: Chalk of the Drawn Line (3)
items.blurb: Draw up to 15 ft. of line; for 8 hours you feel a mental ping (range 1 mile) when a creature crosses it.

items.name: Mendicant's Satchel
items.blurb: Healer's kit that serves as a focus for healing magic; spend its supplies as you restore hp with a spell or class feature to add +1 hp per die rolled.

items.name: Smoke Rounds (5)
items.blurb: Impact blooms a 10-ft.-radius smoke cloud (heavily obscured) for 1 minute; wind disperses it.

items.name: Falconer's Homburg
items.blurb: Weighted, brimmed hat: thrown simple weapons get +1 to attack and damage. Such weapons return to your hand right after the attack, unless restraining after successful attack. The hat is a monk weapon (1d6 scales, thrown 30/90, returning). 1/day cast feather fall on yourself up to 3 allies in 30ft.

items.name: The Showstoppers
items.blurb: Patent-leather boots: +10 ft. speed and difficult terrain does not slow you. 10 charges: bonus action, tap-step teleport 15 ft. to a space you can see.

items.name: Curtain Call
items.blurb: +1 dagger (finesse, light, thrown 20/60). It looks extra fancy, +1 Spell Save DC on Bard Spells. After you throw it, it reappears in its sheath at the start of your next turn.

items.name: Objection, a Main-Gauche
items.blurb: Parrying dagger (1d4 piercing, finesse, light). 3/day, reaction when a melee attack you can see hits you: +2 AC against that attack.

items.name: Ankh of Aten
items.blurb: Golden ankh with 5 charges: spend 1 to fire a 60-ft. line of sunlight (DC 15 Con, 5d8 radiant and blinded). Undead save with disadvantage. Regains 1d6 charges at dawn.

items.name: Apron of the Eager Artisan
items.blurb: Dwarven craft-brotherhood apron from Sebbek Sobor. Spend 10 minutes planning a project and the tools in its pockets become the artisan's tools best suited to it. Once per dawn.

items.name: Ashes of the Fallen
items.blurb: Kushite packet of powdered celestial. Thrown into a 15-ft. cone, spellcasters who fail a DC 15 Wis save miscast random prepared spells for 1 hour.

items.name: Blooddrinker Spear
items.blurb: Gnoll fetish-spear of Dabu. A creature you hit is marked for 1 hour, taking an extra 1d6 from the spear and easy to track. Clean the haft on a short rest to mark someone new.

items.name: Chainbreaker Blade
items.blurb: Free Islands pirate blade turned against the slavers of Shibai. Advantage on attacks to break chains and manacles, which are vulnerable to its slashing damage.

items.name: Crimson Carpet
items.blurb: Red felt bundle that unrolls on command into a hovering, damage-immune bridge up to 10 ft. wide and 60 ft. long. Roll it up and it stays shut until the next dawn.

items.name: Crocodile Armor
items.blurb: Crocodile hide: +1 AC, hold your breath 15 minutes, swim at your walking speed. Intimidation shines against subek and werecrocodiles; every other Charisma check with them suffers.

items.name: Eye of Horus
items.blurb: Gold and lapis lazuli amulet granting advantage on saving throws against fear and illusion spells and effects.

items.name: Eyes of the Portal Masters
items.blurb: Crystal lenses that sense every dimensional portal within 60 ft. and whether it runs one way or two. Ten minutes of wear per day, then dormant until dawn.

items.name: Fly Whisk of Authority
items.blurb: Flick it as an action for advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes. Once per dawn.

items.name: Headrest of the Cattle Queens
items.blurb: Curved wooden sleeping headrest. Six hours on it and your long rest returns an extra Hit Die and removes 2 levels of exhaustion instead of 1.

items.name: Jambiya of the Ebon Night
items.blurb: Rune-cut Sar-Shaban curved dagger, the fruit of demonic tutelage. On a hit, DC 13 Wis save or the target subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saves for 1 minute.

items.name: Keffiyeh of Serendipitous Escape
items.blurb: A plain nomad's headscarf until you spread it open and speak the word, whereupon it becomes a 3-by-5-ft. carpet of flying that obeys you from within 30 ft.

items.name: Kissing Blade of Tik'mbesi
items.blurb: Snowflake obsidian skinning knife of the orc priests of the White Goddess. Deals an extra 3d6 slashing that ignores resistance; Charisma checks against the wounded gain advantage.

items.name: Labrys of the Raging Bull
items.blurb: Double-headed axe granting advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove, and letting you shove creatures up to two sizes larger than you.

items.name: Litham of Breath
items.blurb: Enchanted face covering: you automatically succeed on Constitution saves to avoid exhaustion during high altitude.

items.name: Mantle of the Lion
items.blurb: Omphayan lion pelt: +10 ft. speed and a bite unarmed strike for 1d6 + Str piercing. Charge 20 ft. into a melee hit and the target makes a DC 15 Str save or falls prone.

items.name: Mask of the Leaping Gazelle
items.blurb: Narumbeki horned hunting mask: +10 ft. walking speed and a long jump of up to 25 feet with a 10-foot running start.

items.name: Mbira of Strong Emotions
items.blurb: Thumb piano that floods listeners within 30 ft. with anger, fear, joy, or tranquility (DC 15 Cha negates). Play past an hour and exhaustion creeps in. Once per dawn.

items.name: Morregi Divination Board
items.blurb: Palm-nut casting board bearing the face of the titan Amhara. Ask one question about the next 7 days and hear a true but cryptic answer. Usable once every 7 days.

items.name: Pocket Oasis
items.blurb: Black cloth square that opens onto an extradimensional oasis: fresh water, fruit and nut trees, and rope-trick shelter for ten Medium creatures for 24 hours.

items.name: Prayer Mat
items.blurb: Its iconography reshapes to your deity when you attune. Ten minutes of kneeling prayer restores one expended use of Channel Divinity, once per dawn.

items.name: Rod of the Infernal Realms
items.blurb: Iron rod topped with a withered fiend's hand, favored in Kush and Sar-Shaba. +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, plus a once-daily minute of frightful glowing eyes.

items.name: Saddle of the Cavalry Casters
items.blurb: Self-fitting saddle: enemies have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you and your mount, and you gain advantage on checks to stay mounted and on concentration saves.

items.name: Sandals of the Jungle Wanderer
items.blurb: Soft leather sandals granting fire resistance, safe footing through loose or deep underbrush, and comfort in temperatures up to 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

items.name: Scimitar of the Jungle
items.blurb: Wind Lord steel carried by Tamasheq chieftains. Shrugs off cold and heat from -50 to 150 degrees Fahrenheit; once per dawn a hit pushes a target 15 ft. and knocks it prone.

items.name: Shield of the Seven Heavens
items.blurb: Ishadian virtue-shield prized by paladins: +2 AC atop the shield's own bonus, immunity to charm, fear, and possession, and a reaction bash that shoves a missing attacker 10 ft.

items.name: Slippers of the Cat
items.blurb: Fine black cloth slippers: advantage on Acrobatics checks to keep your balance, and you always land on your feet, halving fall damage on a DC 15 Dex save.

items.name: Spice Box of Zest
items.blurb: City of Brass box holding six spoonfuls each of baharat, cassia, cloves, fiery chilies, saffron, and turmeric. One spice per meal, one hour of effect. Mixing nullifies them.

items.name: Staff of the First Labyrinth
items.blurb: Tes-Qamar minotaur staff. A hit can banish the target to an extradimensional labyrinth (DC 17 Wis) until it escapes with a DC 15 Investigation check. Once per sunrise.

items.name: Vessel of Deadly Venoms
items.blurb: Serpent-coiled jug of Lignas pouring serpent venom, assassin's blood, or a 30-ft. spit of poison (DC 15 Con, 2d8). Doses go inert after 1 hour. Once per dawn.

items.name: Stunted Wing Graft
items.blurb: Translucent back wings that slow your fall to 60 ft. per round and let you glide 10 ft. horizontally for every 5 ft. you descend. They cannot gain altitude.

items.name: Tosculi Antennae
items.blurb: Antennae pressed to your forehead: advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell and on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track a creature. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Carapace
items.blurb: Molded chest carapace: +1 AC, and when an attack damages you, spend your reaction to heal 1d10. Recharges on a short or long rest. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Lenses
items.blurb: Multifaceted lenses: advantage on sight-based Perception and on Insight checks, but disadvantage on saves against gaze attacks and illusions. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Pheromone Glands
items.blurb: Collarbone glands allowing silent speech with other wearers within 30 ft., plus two scent messages a day of up to 25 words that linger for three days. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Spur, Standard
items.blurb: Carapace bracer that extends a finesse, light 1d4 piercing spur as a bonus action and cannot be disarmed. The standard spur grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Spur, Acidic
items.blurb: As the standard spur, with +1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 acid damage on every hit. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Spur, Venomous
items.blurb: A +1 spur you can coat in poison as an action: DC 13 Con save or 2d4 poison damage and poisoned for 1 minute. Once per long rest. 1d4 week lifespan.

items.name: Tosculi Chirurgeon's Tools
items.blurb: Chitin scalpel, forceps, and implements. Proficiency lets you add your proficiency bonus to checks to remove or repair tosculi living items.

items.name: Tosculi Healing Resin
items.blurb: Fist-sized resin shell. Smear it on for 1 minute of regeneration at 3 hp per turn, or use it to repair a damaged tosculi living item.

items.name: Tosculi Saliva
items.blurb: Clay jar of yellowish paste holding 1d6 + 1 applications; detaches a tosculi living item from a helpless, willing, or dead creature with no check required.

items.name: Tosculi Jelly (1 lb.)
items.blurb: Hive jelly. Mixed into alchemist's fire it raises the DC to douse the flames to 12; as a component for black tentacles, grease, or web it gives targets disadvantage.

items.name: Tosculi Paper (one sheet)
items.blurb: Reed pulp cut with tosculi saliva: resistant to fire damage, and its ink survives an hour of water. Spellbooks made from it cost three times the standard price.

items.name: Tamasheq Litham
items.blurb: Layered linen and cotton face wrap worn by Tamasheq nomads: advantage on Constitution saves to avoid exhaustion during high altitude travel.

items.name: Dwarven Naphtha (dose)
items.blurb: Narumbeki liquid firemix, too wet for firearms. Coats a weapon like poison: DC 11 Con or 1d4 fire damage, repeating each turn until two saves succeed.

items.name: Dwarven Naphtha (keg, 100 doses)
items.blurb: One hundred doses in one keg. Expose it to fire or lightning and it detonates: DC 15 Dex save, 8d6 fire within 20 ft., and everything caught risks catching fire.
